name: Superior Metalcraft
old_description: At Superior Metalcraft, we ensure that our custom fabrications are done right the first time. Our Chicago facility has expert craftsmen equipped with the best tools for the job, from welding to coating. Let’s work together to create and install metal structures that improve the safety and efficiency of your operations.
about:
Superior Metalcraft was founded in 2008 in Lansing, Illinois, and operates a fully-equipped fabrication facility in the Chicago area.

The company provides custom metal fabrication and machining services, working with stainless steel, aluminum, and carbon steel. Its capabilities include welding, coating, CNC machining, and production of stair systems, handrails, food processing equipment, platforms, enclosures, ventilation components, hoods, machine guards, and more. Over 18 years in business, it has processed more than 18,000 tons of steel and used 5.1 million feet of welding wire. Superior Metalcraft also offers emergency breakdown repair and high-volume consumable parts production.

It serves industries such as food processing, industrial manufacturing, commercial construction, and architectural metalwork. Customers include facilities requiring OSHA-compliant structures, custom stair and railing systems, and specialized equipment for production environments.

The company emphasizes its expert team, ability to work with difficult metals, commitment to OSHA compliance, and services like emergency repair and high-volume CNC production to minimize downtime and meet exact specifications.
